subject.title: fix(plugins): honor empty contract plugin scopes

question: Should maintainers land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103731 as the canonical complete fix, or merge this narrower PR first and require the sibling to remove its duplicated resolver changes?
rationale: Both same-author branches are correct, mergeable, and proof-positive, but they share identical source and test changes while only the sibling covers the additional source-confirmed bypass; repository policy prevents automatically closing one half of the active pair.

options.title: Land the broader sibling
options.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103731 and close this PR afterward so both confirmed empty-scope paths ship together.

options.title: Land this PR first
options.body: Merge this narrower branch, then rebase the sibling and retain only its unique document-extractor allowlist repair and tests.

recommendation.title: Land the broader sibling
recommendation.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103731 and close this PR afterward so both confirmed empty-scope paths ship together.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work established the canonical explicit plugin-scope contract governing both branches.
